description: Greenery and emission sources around a point (a home): tree canopy share within 300 m, green land share and summer NDVI within 500 m with a low/medium/high level against the rest of the city, the nearest park, up to 10 emission sources (power plants, works and mines within 5 km, landfills within 3 km, boiler houses and single chimneys within 1.5 km) chosen by significance (high/medium/low, from emissions, fuel and size) and distance, with distance, bearing, fuel, confidence, significance, wind_exposure (the share of the time the wind blows from the source to the home, from the wind rose of the region) stack_height_m (smoke from a tall chimney comes down some 10 heights downwind) and, for facilities in the Climate TRACE registry, yearly CO2e; traffic: the nearest motorway, trunk, primary and secondary road and railway within 500 m with a low/medium/high level by distance; terrain: the ground against the mean within 2 km (hollow/level/elevated, Copernicus DEM); measured_air: the yearly and winter PM2.5 mean, days per EPA category and the worst month of the nearest Atmy sensor within 2 km with a year of quality-checked days, and the median of the sensors around (approximate, not official monitoring); and the number of detached houses within 1 km (an estimate of stove smoke, not a count of stoves). Only computed cities; elsewhere the error city_not_covered.
name: get_home_environment
title: Surroundings of a home
